documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

analysis.summary: Management reported a strong performance for the first half of FY27 with healthy growth in revenue and profitability, noting that September marked one year since their stock exchange listing. The demand environment remains encouraging due to ongoing festive and wedding seasons, though gold price volatility has made consumers cautious, leading to a preference for lightweight and affordable jewellery. The company is setting up a wholly-owned subsidiary to expand into new categories such as silver, platinum, 9-karat gold, and B2C online channels. Additionally, management highlighted progress in increasing their business share with major corporate chain stores and expanding the bridal jewellery segment. Shringar House of Mangalsutra Limited released its investor presentation for Q2 and H1 FY27, reporting strong revenue and profit growth alongside an expansion in manufacturing capacity via a new Kandivali facility.

guidance.claim: Management targets scaling their corporate business share from 51% to 65% in the coming days.
guidance.quote: By doing so, We are targeting to scale our corporate business share from 51% to 65% in the coming days.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the demand environment remains encouraging, particularly with the festive and wedding season underway.
demand_outlook.quote: Coming to the industry, the demand environment remains encouraging, particularly with the festive and wedding season underway.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted growing preferences for organized and branded jewellery while volatility and uncertainty in gold price have made consumers more cautious about their spending.
demand_outlook.quote: We are also seeing growing preferences for organized and branded jewellery, while volatility and uncertainty in gold price have made consumers more cautious about their spending.

demand_outlook.claim: Management observed that the demand for lightweight jewellery, contemporary design, and affordable products continues to create opportunities.
demand_outlook.quote: The demand for the lightweight jewellery, contemporary design, and affordable products continues to create opportunities.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that expansion plans of its corporate clientele will drive additional demand for its products.
demand_outlook.quote: The expansion plans of our corporate clientele will drive additional demand for our products

capex_expansion.claim: Management announced the process of setting up a wholly-owned subsidiary to expand presence across the broader jewellery value chain.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of our long-term expansion strategy, we are in the process of setting up a wholly-owned subsidiary to expand our presence across the broader jewellery value chain.

capex_expansion.claim: Commercial production from the current capacity resumed from 23rd February 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: Commercial production from the current capacity resumed from 23rd February 2026.

capex_expansion.claim: Approximately Rs 15 crore was invested via internal accruals to expand capacity, upgrade machinery, improve efficiency, and meet growing demand.
capex_expansion.quote: Approx. ₹15 crore invested via internal accruals to expand capacity, upgrade machinery, improve efficiency, and meet growing demand.

margins_costs.claim: Management explained that if gold prices increase, profitability actually improves because they charge on a percentage basis.
margins_costs.quote: If gold prices increase, our profitability actually improves. The reason is that we charge on a percentage basis.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that employee costs increased due to hiring more designers, artisans, and staff to support capacity expansion and the bridal segment.
margins_costs.quote: Sir, as I mentioned, we have already increased our capacity from 2.5 to 4 tonnes; consequently, we will need to increase our headcount.

margins_costs.claim: Revenue grew 58.7% YoY to Rs 1,367.15 crore in H1 FY27 from Rs 861.41 crore in H1 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Revenue grew 58.7% YoY to ₹1,367.15 crore in H1 FY27 from ₹861.41 crore in H1 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: PAT grew 43.1% YoY to Rs 73.47 crore, with a PAT margin of 5.37%.
margins_costs.quote: PAT grew 43.1% YoY to ₹73.47 crore, with a PAT margin of 5.37%.

margins_costs.claim: Net cash outflow from operating activities improved to -Rs 77.91 crore from -Rs 412.11 crore.
margins_costs.quote: Net cash outflow from operating activities improved to -₹77.91 crore from -₹412.11 crore, supported by lower working capital outflow.

orders_capacity.claim: Sales volume for Q2 stood at 577 kgs, up by 10% year-on-year.
orders_capacity.quote: Sales volume for the quarter stood at 577 kgs, up by 10% Y-0-Y.

orders_capacity.claim: Actual capacity utilization was reported at 87% for the full year taking into account blended capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: The new capacity was added in February 2026. Blended capacity for full year is 2625 kgs. Hence, actual capacity utilization is 87%.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has an installed integrated manufacturing capacity of 4,000 kg per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: 4,000 kg p.a Capacity in an integrated manufacturing facility

risks_headwinds.claim: Management pointed out that volatility and uncertainty in gold price have made consumers more cautious about their spending.
risks_headwinds.quote: We are also seeing growing preferences for organized and branded jewellery, while volatility and uncertainty in gold price have made consumers more cautious about their spending.

risks_headwinds.claim: Risks and uncertainties facing the company include the performance of Indian and international economies, industry competition, and exposure to market risks.
risks_headwinds.quote: These risks and uncertainties include, but are not limited to, the performance of the Indian economy and of the economies of various international markets, the performance of the industry in India and worldwide, competition, the company’s ability to successfully implement its strategy, the Company’s future levels of growth and expansion, technological implementation, changes and advancements, changes in revenue, income or cash flows, the Company’s market preferences and its exposure to market risks, as well as other risks.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets scaling their corporate business share from 51% to 65% in the coming days.
management_commitments.quote: By doing so, We are targeting to scale our corporate business share from 51% to 65% in the coming days.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
